description: Interface defining payment-related services such as processing payments, refunds, retrieving payment methods, and managing payment configurations within the sales management system.

classes.name: PaymentService
classes.description: Java interface for payment processing operations including payment execution, refunds, configuration management, and validation.

methods.name: getPaymentMethods
methods.description: Retrieves available payment methods for a given merchant store.

methods.name: getPaymentModulesConfigured
methods.description: Fetches configured payment modules for a store.

methods.name: processPayment
methods.description: Processes a payment transaction with customer, store, payment details, cart items, and order.

methods.name: processRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund for a specific order and customer.

methods.name: getPaymentMethodByType
methods.description: Retrieves a payment module by payment type (e.g., CREDITCARD, MONEYORDER).

methods.name: getPaymentMethodByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a payment module by its code (e.g., paypal, authorizenet).

methods.name: savePaymentModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Saves configuration for a payment module.

methods.name: validateCreditCard
methods.description: Validates credit card number, type, expiration month, and date.

methods.name: getPaymentConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves configuration for a specific payment module.

methods.name: getAcceptedPaymentMethods
methods.description: Lists accepted payment methods for a store.

methods.name: getPaymentModule
methods.description: Retrieves a PaymentModule by its code.
